svg.aria-label: ExtraTunnel. The privacy layer for AI coding agents. Customer data stays on the laptop. Every request is signed. On the right, the ExtraTunnel tunnel: real values in orange stream into a green seal frame and leave as blue placeholders. Below, Proof you can check, not a promise. One request end to end, with made-up values: an agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor sends Dana Whitfield; the seal turns the name into a stand-in, Rohan Malhotra; the check finds 0 real values left; the AI provider sees only the stand-in; and the restore puts the real name back.
